verse.verse_1: Ta-Seen-Meem. (Alphabets of the Arabic language – Allah, and to whomever he reveals, know their precise meanings.)
verse.verse_2: These are verses of the clear Book.
verse.verse_3: Possibly you may risk your life (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) by grieving, because they did not believe.
verse.verse_4: If We will, We can send down on them a sign from the sky so that their leaders would remain bowed before it.
verse.verse_5: And never does a new advice come to them from the Most Gracious, but they turn away from it.
verse.verse_6: Indeed they have denied, so now soon coming upon them are the tidings of what they used to scoff at.
verse.verse_7: Have they not seen the earth, that how many honourable pairs We have created in it?
verse.verse_8: Indeed in this is a sign; and most of them will not accept faith.
verse.verse_9: And indeed your Lord – indeed only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_10: And (remember) when your Lord said to Moosa, “Go to the unjust people.”
verse.verse_11: “The nation of Firaun; will they not fear?”
verse.verse_12: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they will deny me.”
verse.verse_13: “I feel hesitant, and my tongue does not speak fast, therefore make Haroon also a Noble Messenger.”
verse.verse_14: “And they have an accusation against me, so I fear that they may kill me.”
verse.verse_15: He said, “Not like this (any more); both of you go with Our signs, We are with you, All Hearing.”
verse.verse_16: “Therefore approach Firaun then proclaim, ‘We both are Noble Messengers of the Lord Of The Creation.’
verse.verse_17: ‘That you let the Descendants of Israel go with us.’”
verse.verse_18: Said Firaun, “Did we do not raise you amongst us, as a child? And you spent many years of your life among us!”
verse.verse_19: “And you committed the deed of yours that you committed, and you were ungrateful.”
verse.verse_20: Said Moosa, “I did that at a time when I was unaware of the consequences.” (In anger – See verse 28:15)
verse.verse_21: “I therefore went away from you as I feared you – so my Lord commanded me and appointed me as one of the Noble Messengers.”
verse.verse_22: “And is this some great reward for which you express favour upon me – that you have enslaved the Descendants of Israel?”
verse.verse_23: Said Firaun, “And what is the Lord Of The Creation?
verse.verse_24: Said Moosa, “Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them; if you believe.”
verse.verse_25: Said Firaun to those around him, “Are you not listening with attention?”
verse.verse_26: Said Moosa, “Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers preceding you.”
verse.verse_27: Said Firaun, “This (Noble) Messenger of yours, who has been sent towards you, has no intelligence!”
verse.verse_28: He said, “The Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them; if you have sense.”
verse.verse_29: Said Firaun, “If you ascribe any one else as a God other than me, I will surely imprison you.”
verse.verse_30: Said Moosa, “Even if I bring to you something clear?”
verse.verse_31: Said Firaun, “Then bring it, if you are of the truthful.”
verse.verse_32: So Moosa put down his staff and it became a visible serpent.
verse.verse_33: And he drew forth his hand, thereupon it shone bright before the beholders.
verse.verse_34: Said Firaun to the court members around him, “He is indeed an expert magician.”
verse.verse_35: “He wishes to expel you out of your land by his magic; so what is your advice?”
verse.verse_36: They said, “Stop him and his brother, and send gatherers to the cities.”
verse.verse_37: “To bring to you every expert great magician.”
verse.verse_38: So the magicians were gathered at a set time on a day appointed.
verse.verse_39: And it was said to the people, “Have you (also) gathered?”
verse.verse_40: The people said, “Perhaps we may follow the magicians if they are victorious.”
verse.verse_41: So when the magicians came, they said to Firaun, “Will we get some reward if we are victorious?”
verse.verse_42: He said, “Yes, and you will then become close to me.”
verse.verse_43: Moosa said to them, “Cast whatever you intend to cast.”
verse.verse_44: So they threw down their ropes and their staves and exclaimed, “By the honour of Firaun, indeed victory is ours!”
verse.verse_45: Therefore Moosa put forth his staff – so it immediately began swallowing all their fabrications.
verse.verse_46: The magicians therefore fell down prostrate.
verse.verse_47: They said, “We have accepted faith in the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_49: Said Firaun, “You accepted faith in him before I permitted you! He is indeed your leader who taught you magic; so now you will come to know; I swear, I will certainly cut off your hands and your feet from alternate sides, and crucify all of you.”
verse.verse_50: They said, “No harm (in it), we will return to our Lord.”
verse.verse_51: “We hope that our Lord will forgive us our mistakes, as we are the first to believe.”
verse.verse_52: And We sent the divine revelation to Moosa that, “Journey along with My bondmen within the night, for you will be pursued.”
verse.verse_53: So Firaun sent gatherers into the cities.
verse.verse_54: They announced “These people are a small group.”
verse.verse_55: “And indeed they have angered all of us.”
verse.verse_56: “And indeed we are an alert army.”
verse.verse_57: We therefore got them out from the gardens and water springs.
verse.verse_58: And from treasures and nice houses.
verse.verse_59: So it was; and We made the Descendants of Israel its inheritors.
verse.verse_60: So the Firaun’s people followed them at sunrise.
verse.verse_61: And when the two groups saw each other, those with Moosa said, “They have caught us.”
verse.verse_62: Said Moosa, “Never! Indeed my Lord is with me, He will now show me the way.”
verse.verse_63: So We sent the divine revelation to Moosa that, “Strike the sea with your staff”; thereupon the sea parted; so each part was like a huge mountain.
verse.verse_64: And We brought the others close to that place.
verse.verse_65: And We saved Moosa and all those with him.
verse.verse_67: Indeed in this is surely a sign, and most of them were not Muslims.
verse.verse_68: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_69: And recite to them the news of Ibrahim.
verse.verse_70: When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”
verse.verse_71: They said, “We worship idols, and we keep squatting in seclusion before them.”
verse.verse_72: He said, “Do they hear you when you call?”
verse.verse_73: “Or do they benefit you or harm you?”
verse.verse_74: They said, “In fact we found our forefathers doing likewise.”
verse.verse_75: He said, “Do you see these – (the idols) whom you worship?”
verse.verse_77: “They are all my enemies, except the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_78: “The One Who created me, so He will guide me.”
verse.verse_79: “And the One Who feeds me and gives me to drink.”
verse.verse_80: “And when I fall ill, so it is He Who heals me.”
verse.verse_81: “And He will give me death, then resurrect me.”
verse.verse_82: “And the One Who, upon Whom I pin my hopes, will forgive me my mistakes on the Day of Judgement.”
verse.verse_83: “My Lord, bestow me the command and join me with those who deserve your proximity.”
verse.verse_84: “And give me proper fame among the succeeding generations.”
verse.verse_85: “And make me among the inheritors of the Gardens of serenity.”
verse.verse_86: “And forgive my father* – he is indeed astray.” (His paternal uncle)
verse.verse_87: “And do not disgrace me on the day when everyone will be raised.”
verse.verse_88: “The day when neither wealth will benefit nor will sons.”
verse.verse_89: “Except he who presented himself before Allah, with a sound* heart.” (Intact or unblemished.)
verse.verse_90: And Paradise will be brought close for the pious.
verse.verse_91: And hell will be revealed for the astray.
verse.verse_92: And it will be said to them, “Where are those whom you used to worship?”
verse.verse_93: “Instead of Allah? Will they help you or retaliate?”
verse.verse_94: So they and all the astray were flung into hell.
verse.verse_95: And all the armies of Iblis. (Satan)
verse.verse_96: And they will say, and they will be quarrelling in it:
verse.verse_97: “By oath of Allah, we were indeed in open error.”
verse.verse_98: “When we considered you equal to the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_99: “And none misled us but the guilty.”
verse.verse_100: “So now we do not have any intercessors.” (The believers shall have intercessors, the disbelievers none).
verse.verse_102: “So if only were we to go back, in order to become Muslims!”
verse.verse_103: Indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not believers.
verse.verse_104: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_105: The people of Nooh denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_106: When their fellowman Nooh said to them, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_107: “I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger of Allah to you.”
verse.verse_109: “And I do not ask from you any fee for it; my reward is only upon the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_111: They said, “Shall we believe in you, whereas the abject people are with you?”
verse.verse_112: He said, “What do I know what their deeds are?”
verse.verse_113: “Indeed their account is only upon my Lord, if you perceive.”
verse.verse_114: “And I will not repel the Muslims.”
verse.verse_115: “I am not but clearly a Herald of Warning.”
verse.verse_116: They said, “O Nooh, if you do not desist you will surely be stoned.”
verse.verse_117: He said, “My Lord, my people have denied me.”
verse.verse_118: “Therefore make a decisive judgement between me and them, and rescue me and the believers along with me.”
verse.verse_119: So We saved him and those with him in a laden ship.
verse.verse_120: Then after it, We drowned the rest.
verse.verse_121: Indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not believers.
verse.verse_122: And indeed your Lord, only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_123: (The tribe of) A’ad denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_124: When their fellowman Hud said to them, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_125: “I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger of Allah to you.”
verse.verse_127: “And I do not ask from you any fee for it; my reward is only upon the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_128: “What! You build a structure on every height, to laugh at the passers-by?”
verse.verse_129: “And prefer strong palaces, that perhaps you may live for ever?”
verse.verse_130: “And when you apprehend someone, you seize him mercilessly?”
verse.verse_132: “Fear Him Who has aided you with the things you know.”
verse.verse_133: “He aided you with cattle and sons.”
verse.verse_135: “Indeed I fear upon you the punishment of a Great Day.”
verse.verse_136: They said, “It is the same for us, whether you advise us or not be of the preachers.”
verse.verse_137: “This is nothing but the tradition of former people.”
verse.verse_139: In response they denied him – We therefore destroyed them; indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not believers.
verse.verse_140: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_141: The Thamud tribe denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_142: When their fellowman Saleh said to them, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_143: “I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger of Allah to you.”
verse.verse_145: “And I do not ask from you any fee for it; my reward is only upon the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_146: “Will you be left peacefully in these favours over here?”
verse.verse_148: “And fields and palm-trees, with delicate tendrils?”
verse.verse_149: “And you carve out dwellings in the mountains, with skill?”
verse.verse_151: “And do not follow those who exceed the limits.”
verse.verse_152: “Those who spread turmoil in the earth, and do no reform.”
verse.verse_153: They said, “You are under a magic spell.”
verse.verse_154: “You are just a human like us; therefore bring some sign if you are truthful.”
verse.verse_155: He said, “This is the she-camel – one day shall be her turn to drink, and on the other appointed day, shall be your turn.”
verse.verse_156: “And do not touch her with evil intentions for the punishment of the Great Day will seize you.”
verse.verse_157: So they hamstrung her, and in the morning could only regret.
verse.verse_158: The punishment therefore seized them; indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not believers.
verse.verse_159: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_160: The people of Lut denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_161: When their fellowman Lut said to them, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_162: “I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger of Allah to you.”
verse.verse_164: “And I do not ask from you any fee for it; my reward is only upon the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_165: “What! Among all the creatures, you commit the immoral acts with men?”
verse.verse_166: “And leave the wives your Lord has created for you? In fact you are people who exceed the limits.”
verse.verse_167: They said, “O Lut, if you do not desist, you will be expelled.”
verse.verse_168: He said, “I am disgusted with your works.”
verse.verse_169: “My Lord, rescue me and my family from their deeds.”
verse.verse_170: We therefore rescued him and his entire family.
verse.verse_171: Except one old woman, who stayed behind.
verse.verse_173: And We showered a rain upon them; so what a wretched rain for those who were warned!
verse.verse_174: Indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not Muslims.
verse.verse_175: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_176: The People of the Woods denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_177: When Shuaib said to all of them, “Do you not fear?”
verse.verse_178: “I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger of Allah to you.”
verse.verse_180: “And I do not ask from you any fee for it; my reward is only upon the Lord Of The Creation.”
verse.verse_181: “Measure in full, and do not be of those who reduce.”
verse.verse_183: “And do not give the people their goods diminished, and do not roam the earth causing turmoil.”
verse.verse_184: “And fear Him Who created you and the earlier creations.”
verse.verse_185: They said, “You are under a magic spell.”
verse.verse_186: “You are just a human like us, and indeed we consider you a liar.”
verse.verse_187: “Therefore cause a part of the sky to fall upon us, if you are of the truthful.”
verse.verse_188: He said, “My Lord is Well Aware of what you do.”
verse.verse_189: In response they denied him – therefore the punishment of the day of the tent* seized them; that was indeed a punishment of a Great Day. (The clouds formed a tent and rained fire upon them).
verse.verse_190: Indeed in this is a sign; and most of them were not Muslims.
verse.verse_191: And indeed your Lord – only He is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_192: And indeed this Qur’an has been sent down by the Lord Of The Creation.
verse.verse_193: The Trustworthy Spirit brought it down. (Angel Jibreel – peace be upon him.)
verse.verse_194: Upon your heart, for you to convey warning.
verse.verse_196: And indeed it is mentioned in the earlier Books.
verse.verse_197: And was this not a sign for them, that the scholars of the Descendants of Israel may recognise this Prophet?
verse.verse_198: And had We sent it down upon a person other than an Arab,
verse.verse_199: In order that he read it to them, even then they would not have believed in it.
verse.verse_200: This is how We have made (the habit of) denying embedded in the hearts of the guilty.
verse.verse_201: They will not believe in it to the extent that they see the painful punishment.
verse.verse_202: So it will come upon them suddenly, whilst they will be unaware.
verse.verse_203: They will therefore say, “Will we get some respite?”
verse.verse_204: So do they wish to hasten Our punishment?
verse.verse_205: Therefore observe, that if We give them some comforts for some years, –
verse.verse_206: And then the promise that is given to them, does come upon them-
verse.verse_207: So of what benefit will be the comforts that they were using?
verse.verse_208: And never did We destroy a township which did not have Heralds of warning, –
verse.verse_209: To advise; and We never oppress.
verse.verse_210: And this Qur’an was not brought down by the devils.
verse.verse_211: They are unworthy of it, nor can they do it.
verse.verse_212: Indeed they have been banished from the place of hearing.
verse.verse_213: Therefore do not worship another deity along with Allah, for you will be punished.
verse.verse_214: And O dear Prophet (Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), warn your closest relatives.
verse.verse_215: And spread your wing of mercy for the believers following you.
verse.verse_216: So if they do not obey you, then say, “Indeed I am unconcerned with what you do.”
verse.verse_217: And rely upon (Allah) the Almighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_218: Who watches you when you stand up.
verse.verse_219: And watches your movements among those who prostrate in prayer.
verse.verse_220: Indeed only He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verse.verse_221: Shall I inform you upon whom do the devils descend?
verse.verse_222: They descend on every great accuser, extreme sinner. (The magicians)
verse.verse_223: The devils convey upon them what they heard, but most of them are liars.
verse.verse_224: And the astray follow the poets.
verse.verse_225: Did you not see that they keep wandering in every valley?
verse.verse_226: And they speak what they do not do?
verse.verse_227: Except those who believed and did good deeds, and profusely remembered Allah, and took revenge after they had been wronged*; and soon the unjust will come to know upon which side they will be overturned**. (* The Muslim poets who praise Allah and the Prophet. ** The disbelievers will be punished.)
